# Not a heading
Plain text is shown exactly as typed, in a monospace face.

* not a bullet
- not a bullet either
1. not a numbered list
> not a quote
**not bold**, _not italic_, `not code`, [not a link](https://example.com)
![not an image](nope.png)

title: not frontmatter
---

    four leading spaces stay four leading spaces
	a leading tab stays a tab
trailing spaces   

Blank lines above and below are kept.
